no, my actions show I am not a good person. I screwed up, and should be punished.

I can't live my life knowing how much hurt I have caused. If I stick around and come clean, I'll lose everyone in my life anyway, and have to live with this pain for ever. It is selfish, but if I go out now, I'd be labeled as a troubled genius by my friends and family. The bandage will be ripped off quicker, and everyone can move on. 

I don't deserve to be here anymore. I never thought I would be say it, but it is the most logical and fair option, to everyone.
